summary: Lake Mountain lookout near Salmon: camp 1918, log cabin and L-4 cab in the 1920s-30s, CCC building 1938, vandalized 1973, gone 1974 (destroyed or removed, sources differ).

facts.design: L-4 cab on a log cabin; 1938 CCC building on an eight-foot log base with a railed platform
facts.status_note: Vandalized 1973; gone by 1974. Sources differ: destroyed (two sources) or removed (one). No source describes the site today.

staffing.status: Named lookouts in 1923 (trapper), 1941 (Joseph Howard) and 1951 (Edwin Peterson); in 1955 still occupied as a radio relay station

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com gives a log cabin in 1928; Forest Lookouts gives a flat-top log cabin in 1931. The sources do not reconcile the two, so the story gives both.

Forest Lookouts says an L-4 cab was added in 1934; firelookout.com dates the L-4 to 1938, when the old cabin became a garage. The 1938 Recorder-Herald item describes a new CCC building that firelookout.com does not mention; the sources do not say how the two fit together.
Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed in 1974; Forest Lookouts says removed in 1974. The story reports both and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Two web searches for the site today (Lake Mountain Salmon radio; Lake Mountain lookout site) returned no current description, so the today section is a gap. Idaho Fire Lookouts' 1918, 1928 and 1974 lines use en dashes and were not quoted. Record kind is two_story; the 1938 item describes an eight-foot log base with a walk-around platform, which does not settle the storey count, so the record was not changed.
